description: Variable Leader metadata for pyadps v1.0.0. Includes raw fields, composite time fields, and decoded bit-field derivatives for xarray.Dataset integration. Variable Leader data changes with each ensemble and contains sensor measurements and timestamps.
source: WorkHorse ADCP Commands and Output Data Format (RDI Specification), Section 5.3, Page 132-137

0.name: variable_leader_id
0.description: Identifier for Variable Leader data structure (0x0080 or 0x0081).

1.name: ensemble_number
1.description: Sequential ensemble number (lower 16 bits, LSB). Combined with Ensemble MSB for full number up to 16,777,215.
1.comments: Increments with each ensemble. See ensemble_msb for full counter.

2.name: rtc_year
2.description: Year from RTC (Real-Time Clock). Year 2000 = 0, year 2001 = 1, etc.
2.comments: Set by TS command. Add 2000 to get actual year.

4.name: rtc_day
4.description: Day of month from RTC (Real-Time Clock).
4.comments: Day of month (1-31). Set by TS command.

5.name: rtc_hour
5.comments: Hour (0-23, UTC). Set by TS command.

8.name: rtc_hundredth
8.description: Hundredth of second from RTC (Real-Time Clock).
8.comments: Hundredths of second (0-99). Set by TS command.

9.name: ensemble_msb
9.description: Most Significant Byte for ensemble number. Increments when Ensemble Number rolls over.

10.name: bit_result
10.description: Results of WorkHorse ADCP Built-In Test (BIT). Zero = successful.
10.comments: 0 = BIT passed. Non-zero values indicate test failures.

11.name: sound_speed
11.description: Sound speed in water at transducer head.
11.comments: EC command sets initial value. May be sensor-derived or manual.

12.name: transducer_depth
12.description: Depth of transducer below water surface.
12.comments: ED command sets initial value. Units: decimeters (dm). May be sensor or manual.

13.name: heading
13.comments: EH command sets initial value. Range: 0-359.99. May be sensor or manual.

14.name: pitch
14.comments: EP command sets initial value. Range: -20 to +20. Positive = Beam#3 higher than Beam#4.

15.name: roll
15.comments: ER command sets initial value. Range: -20 to +20. Positive = Beam#2 or Beam#1 higher depending on orientation.

16.name: salinity
16.description: Salinity of water at transducer head.
16.comments: ES command sets initial value. Units: Practical Salinity Units (PSU). Used in sound speed calculation.

17.name: temperature
17.comments: ET command sets initial value. Units: oC. Range: -5 to +40 degree Celcius. Used in sound speed calculation.

18.name: mpt_minute
18.description: Minutes portion of time to complete pinging in current ensemble (MPT).
18.comments: Time elapsed to collect pings for this ensemble.

19.name: mpt_second
19.description: Seconds portion of time to complete pinging in current ensemble (MPT).
19.comments: Time elapsed to collect pings for this ensemble.

20.name: mpt_hundredth
20.long_name: Measurement Posting Time - Hundredths of Second
20.description: Hundredths of second portion of time to complete pinging (MPT).
20.comments: Time elapsed to collect pings for this ensemble.

21.name: heading_std_dev
21.description: Standard deviation (accuracy) of heading from gyrocompass/sensors.
21.comments: Indicates compass accuracy/uncertainty. Units: 0.1 degree resolution.

22.name: pitch_std_dev
22.description: Standard deviation (accuracy) of pitch from tilt sensor.
22.comments: Indicates pitch sensor accuracy/uncertainty. Units: 0.1 degree resolution.

23.name: roll_std_dev
23.description: Standard deviation (accuracy) of roll from tilt sensor.
23.comments: Indicates roll sensor accuracy/uncertainty. Units: 0.1 degree resolution.

37.name: pressure
37.description: Water pressure at transducer head relative to one atmosphere.
37.comments: Units: decapascals (dPa). Gauge pressure (relative to 1 atm).

38.name: pressure_variance
38.description: Variance (deviation about mean) of pressure sensor data.

40.name: y2k_century
40.description: Century field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).
40.comments: TT command sets value. 19=1900s, 20=2000s. Replaces RTC fields for Y2K compliance.

41.name: y2k_year
41.description: Year field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).
41.comments: TT command sets value. Year within century (0-99).

42.name: y2k_month
42.description: Month field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).

43.name: y2k_day
43.description: Day field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).
43.comments: TT command sets value. Day of month (1-31).

44.name: y2k_hour
44.description: Hour field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).
44.comments: TT command sets value. Hour (0-23, UTC).

45.name: y2k_minute
45.description: Minute field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).

46.name: y2k_second
46.description: Second field from Y2K-compliant real-time clock (RTC).

47.name: y2k_hundredth

rtc_datetime.name: rtc_datetime
rtc_datetime.derived_from: rtc_year, rtc_month, rtc_day, rtc_hour, rtc_minute, rtc_second, rtc_hundredth
rtc_datetime.description: Composite UTC datetime from RTC fields. Combines year, month, day, hour, minute, second, hundredth into a single datetime64[ns].
rtc_datetime.comments: Primary timestamp for data. Year adjusted by adding 2000. Provides single datetime variable for xarray.

y2k_datetime.name: y2k_datetime
y2k_datetime.derived_from: y2k_century, y2k_year, y2k_month, y2k_day, y2k_hour, y2k_minute, y2k_second, y2k_hundredth
y2k_datetime.description: Composite UTC datetime from Y2K RTC fields. Combines century, year, month, day, hour, minute, second, hundredth into a single datetime64[ns].
y2k_datetime.comments: Y2K-compliant timestamp. Preferred over rtc_datetime for new deployments. Provides full 4-digit year.

notes.implementation: This metadata file supports raw fields and composite datetime fields. Use raw_fields for direct binary values and composite_fields for interpreted timestamps.
notes.coordinates: All fields vary by ensemble. Use ensemble dimension as primary coordinate.
notes.cf_conventions: Metadata follows CF Conventions 1.10 standards with UDUNITS2 unit strings.
notes.netcdf_compliance: File can be exported to NetCDF4 as CF-compliant Dataset.
notes.composite_fields: Datetime fields are derived from raw fields and should be calculated at read time, not stored separately in memory-intensive xarray Dataset.
notes.time_handling: Both RTC and Y2K fields are provided. Y2K fields provide better Y2K compliance. Prefer y2k_datetime for new code.
notes.sensor_fields: Fields like heading, pitch, roll, temperature, salinity are sensor readings that vary per ensemble.
notes.diagnostic_fields: ADC channels, error status, measurement posting time, and standard deviations are diagnostic/quality indicators.
notes.backward_compatibility: Old code accessing raw values will continue to work via accessors. New code should use composite datetime fields for clarity.
